snippet.title: Shadowrun (2007) - FASA Developer AMA
snippet.description:
The Shadowrun 2007 community sits down with the original developers from FASA studios to reminisce and talk about what made this game such an underrated and hidden gem.

A big thank you to David (dj) Johnson (Bot name Undertone) for getting his former colleagues and good friends to come together and answer questions about a project they all worked on together, more than 16 years in the past.

This video is in part possible because of the resurgence that happened in July 2023, thanks to some key members of the Shadowrun community.

The AMA was meant to capture and archive the meeting with some of the key members of the FASA studio dev team, who got a chance to rekindle their thoughts and memories about their time passionately working on Shadowrun, and to answer questions from the community that still passionately plays their game today.

You can see clearly that despite 16 years of passing time, and many other projects to fill that timeline, these guys still have fond and detailed memories of the Shadowrun they loved to develop and play.

Want to play? Join the discord!
discord.gg/shadowrun
